items.stem: When is a channel preferable to a one-to-one or group chat in Teams?

options.text: When the conversation and its files should be shared and searchable by the team
options.rationale: Correct: channels keep shared, searchable, persistent work for the whole team.

options.text: When the message must never be seen again
options.rationale: Channels persist content; they do not hide it.

options.text: When you want to avoid storing any files
options.rationale: Channel files are stored in SharePoint.

options.text: Only when the team has exactly two members
options.rationale: Channels serve teams of any size.

items.explanation: Correct: a channel is preferable when the conversation and its files should be shared and searchable by the whole team.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO statements about Teams channels are correct? (Select TWO.)

options.text: A private channel restricts membership to a subset of the team
options.rationale: Correct: private channels have their own restricted membership.

options.text: A channel's files are stored in SharePoint
options.rationale: Correct: channel files live in the team's SharePoint site.

options.text: Every channel is always visible to the whole internet
options.rationale: Channels are not public to the internet.
Channels support tabs for apps and files.

items.explanation: Correct: private channels restrict membership, and channel files are backed by SharePoint.

items.stem: Why review meeting options such as the lobby before an external meeting?

options.text: To control who can bypass the lobby and who can present
options.rationale: Correct: meeting options govern lobby and presenter roles.
Meetings start regardless; options refine control.

options.text: To reduce the file size of the recording
options.rationale: Options are about access, not file size.

options.text: Because the lobby deletes the meeting chat
options.rationale: The lobby does not delete chat.

items.explanation: Correct: meeting options let you control who bypasses the lobby and who can present.
